name: traffic-blocker
description: Shopify app that lets merchants restrict storefront traffic by country, IP, ASN, bot policy, and custom rules.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @traffic-blocker/backend" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @traffic-blocker/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/shared-types && npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/country-data && npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/analytics-utils && npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/rule-schemas && npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/backend && npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/admin && npm run build -w @traffic-blocker/storefront
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @traffic-blocker/backend && npm run typecheck -w @traffic-blocker/admin && npm run typecheck -w @traffic-blocker/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @traffic-blocker/rule-schemas && npm run typecheck -w @traffic-blocker/country-data && npm run typecheck -w @traffic-blocker/analytics-utils
